# ⛔ GENERATED — do not edit

Everything in this directory is generated from `spec/openapi.yaml` (the Dona API contract) by
`make generate`. CI regenerates it on every push and **fails if the committed files differ** — a
hand edit cannot land. To change the SDK, change the contract (OZB `architecture/DB/seller-api/contract/`),
or the generator setup under `generators/`, then run `make generate` and commit the result.

Install, authentication, rate limits, idempotency, `dry_run` and the `202 held_for_review` shape:
see the repository [README](../../README.md). Runnable examples: [`examples/`](../../examples/).
